title: Copy Cat Grid
description: make_board(rows, cols, row, col) builds a rows × cols grid of zeros and marks a single cell with 1. One mark appears in every row.
code:
def make_board(rows, cols, row, col):
    board = [[0] * cols] * rows
    board[row][col] = 1
    return board
solution:
def make_board(rows, cols, row, col):
    board = [[0] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    board[row][col] = 1
    return board
hint: `[x] * 3` makes a list with the same `x` three times. Is it three copies of the row, or three references to one row?
explanation: `[[0] * cols] * rows` repeats a reference to the same inner list, so every row is the same object and changing one changes them all. Build a new row for each index with a list comprehension.
